metadata.purpose: Live baseline evidence run 2026-07-21: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B MTP, main router port 8080, noThink=true, maxTokens=4096 (thinking model needs room for think block)

issue253Comparability.note: maxTokens was already 4096; no change required to equalize with the coder-30b profile for #253 pairing (see qwen3-coder-30b-live.json, which was raised from 512 to 4096).

metadata.noThinkIsIntentionalAsymmetry: noThink=true is preserved intentionally: qwen3.6-35b is a reasoning model that requires the /no_think directive to bound its think block within maxTokens, whereas qwen3-coder-30b is a non-reasoning model and carries no noThink field. This is a known, model-intrinsic difference between the two #253 profiles, not an uncontrolled variable.
